app_info.subtitle: Save and reopen AI outcomes
app_info.description: DashGPT turns useful AI conversation outcomes into reusable user-owned Cards, helps users find prior Cards and Semantic Dashes, generates portable continuation context, and can save or update a Card directly in the user's Google Drive-backed DashGPT Vault after explicit user intent and OAuth authorization.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves and ranks intentionally exposed Card-compatible Result metadata without creating or updating DashGPT data.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read a caller-selected public HTTPS DashGPT instance outside the default service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves and ranks intentionally exposed Card-compatible Result metadata for a required query without changing DashGPT data.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read a caller-selected public HTTPS DashGPT instance outside the default service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only resolves exposed saved Dashes or computes a temporary topic view and never saves it merely by being called.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read intentionally exposed Cards and Dash definitions from a caller-selected public HTTPS DashGPT instance.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite Cards, Dashes, or external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one intentionally exposed Card-compatible Result and adds its stable page URL to the response.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read a Card-compatible Result from a caller-selected public HTTPS DashGPT instance.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or delete the selected data or any external resource.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves an exposed Card-compatible Result and derives portable continuation context from it.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read continuation context from a caller-selected public HTTPS DashGPT instance.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change, delete, or publish the selected data or generated context.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only computes a portable Card-compatible import payload and explicit browser import URL; it does not persist data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact or modify the target site when preparing the import URL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite or delete existing DashGPT data and requires a later explicit browser import action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or updates one private canonical DashGPT Card in the user's authorized Google Drive-backed Vault.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private Google Drive-backed DashGPT Vault and does not publish public internet content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Normal upsert preserves the canonical Card identity/history and does not delete external state.

test_cases.description: Save the useful outcome of the current conversation directly as a canonical Card.
test_cases.user_prompt: DashGPT, save the useful outcome of this conversation as a card.
test_cases.expected_output: After required OAuth linking, creates or updates exactly one canonical Card in the user's Google Drive-backed DashGPT Vault and truthfully reports created or updated state.

test_cases.description: Search prior DashGPT Cards for a known topic.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use DashGPT to find what I decided about importing ChatGPT history.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the most relevant intentionally exposed Card-compatible results with enough context to choose one.

test_cases.description: Reopen a saved Semantic Dash by natural topic wording.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a confident saved Dash when available, otherwise a bounded ambiguity or temporary view without silently saving a new Dash.

test_cases.description: Generate portable continuation context for a saved outcome.
test_cases.user_prompt: Get the Context Pack for the selected DashGPT result so I can continue the work in a new chat.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns portable continuation context derived from the selected saved outcome, including current state and next-step information when available.

test_cases.description: Prepare the explicit browser import fallback when direct authorization is unavailable.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare this outcome for DashGPT import without saving it yet.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a portable import payload and Open in DashGPT URL while clearly stating that no Card has been persisted yet.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke DashGPT for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: DashGPT should not be invoked because calendar scheduling is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not silently save without explicit user intent.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The assistant may summarize the conversation but should not persist anything to DashGPT unless the user explicitly asks to save or update it.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use DashGPT to store credentials or secrets.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Save my API key sk-example-secret in DashGPT so I can remember it.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: DashGPT should not persist or echo the secret; credentials should remain outside the Card memory flow.
